name: Point
description: Width fork. Its own keys are ranges such as 0-479 and 480-5000, and each value is the OML node for that width. The same range object can be the point property of another node.
access: OML addresses it as selector:Point. The point property of a view uses the same range object. Call methods on the instance. Method names are not OML keys. Read oml://app for the range shape.

properties.name: target
properties.description: Optional element to measure. When this is omitted, Point uses the parent width.
